references.text: Parallel legislation concerning unclean birds in Deuteronomy, mentioning the same birds that are to be considered abominable.
Complete list of unclean birds corresponding to the list in Leviticus 11, including eagle, vulture, and sea eagle.
Continuation of the list of unclean birds that the Lord forbade the Israelites to eat.
The Lord commands Israel to distinguish between clean and unclean animals and birds, as explained in chapter 11.
Ezekiel refers to birds of prey gathering, reflecting knowledge of unclean birds from the Mosaic Law.
Peter's vision with unclean animals and birds, where God declares that what God has cleansed, people must not call unclean.
